senses.gloss: दुष्˚ duṣ-, indec. (= dus-) bad, ill, hard, un-, 🞄dis-.

दुष्कृति duṣkṛti, ˚न् -n, a. sinning;
 m. 🞄miscreant, sinner.

दुष्टात्मन् duṣṭa‿ātman, a. ill-disposed, malevolent;
 🞄-antarātman, a. id..
दुष्टि duṣ-ṭi, f. corruptness.
दुष्टुति duṣṭuti, v. दुःष्टुति duḥṣṭuti.
दुष्मन्त duṣmanta, m. incorr. form of Duṣyanta.
दुष्यन्त duṣyanta, m. N. of Śakuntalāʼs husband 🞄and of Bharataʼs father.
दुस्थ du-stha, ˚स्थित -sthita, v. दुः˚ duḥ-.
दुस्सनि dussani, m. N..
दूषि dūṣ-i, a. destroying (—˚).
दूषी dūṣ-ī, ˚का -kā, rheum of the eye.
दूषिन् dūṣ-in, a. polluting, deflowering (—˚).

दूष्य 1. dūṣ-ya, fp. liable to be spoiled, 🞄ruined, or polluted;
 m. reprehensible person.

दूष्य 2. dūṣ-ya, n. tent;
